Kameshvari. Chausath Yogini Temple, Hirapur

should be a parrot, but here is some other animal.

images.caption:
Seated Bhairava. Chausath Yogini Temple, Hirapur
Bhairava is seated in "royal ease" (lalitasana)
upon a lotus throne,
above a prostrated female and a
smaller female attendant. His upper right hand holds a drum, and his
other arms are missing.
The sculpture is situated in the right niche beside the
entrance to the cella of the temple

images.caption: A statue of a lion, the king of the jungle, looks over the plains of Daya river from his perch atop the Dhauligiri hills in Bhubaneswar, India. The hill is famous for Ashoka’s rock edicts and a dazzling white peace pagoda. Dhauli hill is presumed to be the area where Kalinga War was fought by Ashoka.
